game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Sandstone Arch, a natural sandstone arch: the caravan guide must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Logic Detective: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstone Arch: a natural sandstone arch
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstone Arch, repeat each round: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug. Each round, vultures strike the sandstone arch, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clues value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the sandstone arch from vultures in Sandstone Arch: keep the clues meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: clues drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 3 (intro tier): Logic Detective
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Logic Detective' (Week 9 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sandstone Arch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clues changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Sandstone Arch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 50 seconds while clues > 0.
